meta.title: Korea Trip — Nov 1–9, 2026
meta.method: Each value was checked against an official source (government, national tourism, operator or venue official site). Where no official value was found, the verified field is blank and the row is flagged. Day-of-week values are calculated from the calendar, not from a source.

status_legend.Verified: Official source confirms the submitted value.
status_legend.Corrected: Official source gives a different value. The official value is shown; the submitted value is kept for reference.
status_legend.Partially verified: Official source confirms part of the entry. The rest is flagged.
status_legend.Unverified: No official source found. Verified field left blank; flagged.
status_legend.Calculated: Day-of-week calculated from the 2026 calendar. Not from an external source.

rows.item: AREX Express, Incheon Airport → Seoul Station: travel time
rows.verified: 43 min from Terminal 1; 51 min from Terminal 2 (non-stop Express)
rows.note: Official AREX: 43 min from T1, 51 min from T2. The All-Stop train (about 59 min T1 / 66 min T2) is per Seoul Metropolitan Government's airport guide.

rows.verified: ₩13,000 (adult, non-member); ₩9,500 (child)
rows.note: The fare is in won, not dollars. Official AREX ticket page: ₩13,000 non-member adult, ₩12,500 member adult, ₩9,500 child. Exchange rate not applied.

rows.item: Airport Limousine bus, Incheon Airport → Myeongdong (6015 / 6001)
rows.verified: ₩17,000 adult per Incheon Airport official listing of airport bus fares
rows.note: The official listing is for the 'Seoul to Incheon Airport (Direct)' route; the same fare is shown for the other direction. Route-level confirmation for 6015 / 6001 not yet done. Operator FAQ: buy the airport-departure ticket at the airport before boarding (no online ticketing).
rows.source_name: Incheon Airport official — Airport bus fare list

rows.item: Airport Limousine bus — boarding rule at airport
rows.verified: Tickets must be bought before boarding when leaving the airport. Pay on board when going to the airport.
rows.note: Operator FAQ, Airport Limousine.
rows.source_name: Airport Limousine — FAQ (how to pay the bus fare)

rows.submitted: AREX (45 min, $7) or Airport Limousine bus ($13)

rows.verified: Fastest trains about 2h15m; many trains 2h30m–3h depending on stops (third-party guides)
rows.note: Official timetable not read. Third-party guides only. Check the train you book.

rows.item: KTX standard fare, Seoul → Busan (one way)
rows.verified: ₩54,400 standard (from 1 Sep 2026); was ₩59,800 before
rows.note: Confirmed by Seoul Economic Daily reporting the Ministry's announcement (31 Aug 2026), not by Korail's own fare table. Confirm on the Korail+ app before booking.
rows.source_name: Seoul Economic Daily — KTX fare cut (31 Aug 2026)

rows.verified: From 1 Sep 2026 SRT trains run under the KTX name and bookings move to the Korail+ app (per Khan, 2 Aug 2026).
rows.note: Confirmed by Korean press reporting the approved merger. Official Korail announcement not fetched. Confirm the departure station (Seoul Station or Suseo) when booking.

rows.item: Board KTX 45 minutes early to secure luggage space
rows.note: Planning advice, not an official rule. Consider an earlier train if luggage is heavy.

rows.item: Uber / taxi to Seoul Station and to hotel
rows.verified: Uber in Seoul is provided through licensed taxis (Uber Taxi / UT), not private drivers
rows.note: Use a licensed-taxi app or street taxi. Uber's private-driver service is not available in Korea.
